components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The ink pill for LinkedIn, the one way to get in touch.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: 9999px; font: 400 16px/1 var(--font, system-ui); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--ink, #26251e); color: var(--on-ink, #f7f7f4); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--ink-hover, #3b3a31); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #f54e00); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A soft-fill pill for every other profile.
components.css: .ds-btn2 { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--fill, #e6e5e0); color: var(--ink, #26251e); font: 400 16px/1 var(--font, system-ui); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-btn2:hover { background: var(--fill-hover, #dcdbd5); } .ds-btn2:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #f54e00); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Link
components.description: The one orange link that may close a block.
components.html: More on Medium →
components.css: .ds-link { color: var(--link, #b83a00); font: 400 16px/1.5 var(--font, system-ui); text-decoration: none; } .ds-arrow { display: inline-block; margin-left: 4px; transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-link:hover .ds-arrow { transform: translateX(2px); } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #f54e00); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 4px; }

components.name: Header Nav
components.description: Section links in ink that fade to 75% on hover.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 32px; font: 400 14px/1.5 var(--font, system-ui); } .ds-nav a { color: var(--ink, #26251e); text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-nav a:hover { color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--ink, #26251e) 75%, transparent); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #f54e00); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 4px; }

components.name: Writing Row
components.description: A full-width filled strip linking to an article.
components.html: Charles Proxy macOS Setup GuideInspect HTTP and HTTPS traffic between your machine and devices.↗
components.css: .ds-row { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 8px 24px; padding: 20px 24px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--surface, #f2f1ed); color: var(--ink, #26251e); font: 400 16px/1.5 var(--font, system-ui); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-row::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--ink, #26251e) 2.5%, transparent); border-radius: inherit; pointer-events: none; } .ds-row-main { display: grid; gap: 4px; } .ds-row-desc, .ds-row-meta { color: var(--muted, #66655e); font-size: 14px; } .ds-row:hover { background: var(--surface-hover, #ebeae5); } .ds-row:hover .ds-row-meta { color: var(--ink, #26251e); } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #f54e00); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Logo Tile
components.description: One client logo, in ink, centred at the band's single logo height.
components.css: .ds-tile { position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 180px; height: 100px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--surface, #f2f1ed); color: var(--ink, #26251e); } .ds-tile::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--ink, #26251e) 2.5%, transparent); border-radius: inherit; }

components.name: Window Tab List
components.description: The sidebar of a feature window: an ARIA tab list in the system face.
components.html: Repositories 6
components.css: .ds-side { width: 208px; padding: 12px 8px; background: var(--window-chrome, #f2f1ed); font: 400 12px/1.4 system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #26251e); } .ds-label { display: flex; gap: 8px; margin: 0; padding: 0 8px 8px; color: var(--muted, #66655e); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-tab { display: grid; width: 100%; padding: 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: inherit; font: inherit; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-tab:hover { background: rgba(38, 37, 30, 0.04); } .ds-tab[aria-selected="true"] { background: var(--fill, #e6e5e0); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #f54e00); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-sub { color: var(--muted, #66655e); font-size: 11px; }

narrative.overview:
The page is a warm surface with the work laid out on it. Nothing raises its voice: the canvas is cream or warm near-black, type sits at weight 400, and depth comes from filled surfaces a shade off the canvas rather than from borders or shadows. The craft shows in precision, not decoration: one left edge for every section, a 4px spacing grid, one type scale, and logos cropped tight so that one height means the same thing for every brand.

The language is borrowed from cursor.com and stays with it: a 1300px page with a 20px gutter, a 52px header, pill buttons, a centred logo band, and feature blocks that pair a short text with an app window on a painted wallpaper. Those two windows (Selected work and Stack) are the only raised objects and the page's focal point. They are real controls: tab lists that swap a README-style document, set in the system face like Cursor's own product UI.

Light and dark are equals. The theme follows the system until the toggle is used, every colour has a dark counterpart, and the wallpaper is veiled in dark mode so the windows still lead.
keyCharacteristics: Warm cream (#f7f7f4) or warm near-black (#14120b) canvas; never pure white or grey.
Weight 400 for every heading, from the 22px titles to the 72px closing line.
Filled surfaces with a barely-there 1px hairline (the ink at 2.5%) instead of borders.
Two app windows, the only shadows on the page.
Orange only for focus rings and text links.
One public-domain painting (Twachtman's "Winter Harmony") as the windows' wallpaper, and no other imagery.

rules.name: The One Orange Rule
rules.body: Orange marks focus and text links, and nothing else. No orange fills, borders, icons or headings.

rules.name: The Token-Only Rule
rules.body: Every colour comes from a token in `css/style.css` with a value for both themes. No raw colours in components.

rules.name: The Flat Weight Rule
rules.body: Headings are weight 400. Size, not weight, makes hierarchy; only the windows' document headings are bold, because they imitate a README.

rules.name: The Scale-Only Rule
rules.body: Every `font-size` is a type-scale token. No one-off sizes, and nothing below 11px.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: No labels or eyebrows above headings.

rules.name: The Two Windows Rule
rules.body: Only the feature windows are raised. Everything else is flat, so the eye goes to the work.

dos: Do take every colour, size, space and radius from the tokens in `css/style.css`.
Do give every new filled surface the 2.5% hairline on a `::before` layer.
Do crop logos tight to their artwork and render them as single-colour `currentColor` SVGs.
Do make every link and button at least a 44px touch target below 640px, with an invisible hit area for small text links.
Do check both themes; a change is finished only when light and dark are equally polished.
donts: Don't use orange for anything but focus rings and text links.
Don't add shadows outside the two feature windows, or borders and rules between sections.
Don't bold a heading, or put a label above one.
Don't add gradients, decorative motion or imagery beyond the windows' wallpaper.
Don't let a window run toward its block's text, or let its document run past the panel's edge.
Don't use cursor.com's own wallpaper or marks.
